package.description: Western Digital Security tool to create, change and modify the password for Western Digital drives

en-US.description: Western Digital Security tool to create, change and modify the password for Western Digital drives
en-US.longDescription:
WD Security features the ability to:

- Create a password to keep others from accessing the files on the drive
- Change the password
- Remove password protection
- Unlock drive

Supported Products:

My Passport, My Book, WD Drive Plus, WD Backup Drive
